packets.reason: Exact artifact-local builders, including aliases and non-UI branches; exposure is separately gated by model/layout.

controls.reason: Native model/layout-gated controls, finite held lifecycle and cancellation-safe STOP. Safety substitutions have separate explicit entries.

settings.reason: Native alarm drafts/commit, privacy persistence, strength selection, model-gated snore/demo/sleep; measured state is separately published.

parsers.reason: Exact valid field extraction and model-specific endian/remapping; unknown auxiliary field remains neutral. Unsafe malformed/callback defects separately excluded.

selection.reason: Explicit app bed type, four models and seven layouts; automatic constructor case rules and FFF0 refinement. No global shared-UUID app inference.

session.reason: Exact service-scoped writer/notify prerequisites, with-response payload forwarding, bounded notification retry, time/alarm hydration and owned lifecycle cleanup. Android/phone-specific policy separately excluded.

queries.reason: Alarm, massage twice/once and P4 status refresh are native actions with exact model gates and bytes. UI page navigation itself is excluded.

dead.reason: No stable selected model/layout route, false phase guard, dormant native endpoint, or non-model no-write branch in accepted artifact. No capability is inferred from stale callbacks.

p2-lighting.reason: Safety: P2 underbedLighting allocates no light opcode and submits arbitrary prior data immediately and every 200ms; that data can be a held motor command. Replaying it is unsafe and inventing another opcode is prohibited.

phone.reason: Unrelated phone rendering/navigation/visual pressed state, local widget/Bloc machinery or notification copy. Corresponding reachable BLE/settings actions are separately indexed and implemented; these are not additional bed features.
tests: custom_components/adjustable_bed/frontend/src/discovery.test.ts::AdjustaMattress model-gated controls and neutral reported fields stay visible

android.reason: Unrelated Android/Flutter BLE plugin implementation and SDK mechanics (permissions, MTU/PHY, native MethodChannel, GATT mutex, CCCD API versions, cache/bond receiver). HA/Bleak owns that platform boundary. Relevant app-local roles/with-response/notify prerequisites are implemented by session rule.

support.reason: Unrelated framework/engine/SDK/launcher/storage/resource/metadata or inventory container. No extra app packet writer exists in accepted closure. Protocol-bearing children/constants are covered by explicit command, control, parser, model and session inventories; raw index containers are not independent bed features.

timer-safety.reason: Safety: unbounded release-started P2 timer refresh, orphaned refresh after disconnect and mutable cross-operation delayed-buffer substitution can retain/replay motion or suppress the required STOP. HA bounds the exact action bytes, serializes the whole operation, and finishes an immutable STOP before releasing ownership.

parser-defects.reason: Safety/correctness: malformed indexed reads, unknown-fragment resets to invented zeros, and suppressed on-only callbacks are app defects, not device semantics. Reject incomplete fields atomically and publish complete valid telemetry.

network.reason: Product boundary: Wi-Fi/SSID/password/network administration, cloud/accounts and unrelated companion infrastructure, even if carried over BLE. No app-owned such BLE command exists in the accepted complete writer inventory; generic engine/SDK network candidates remain excluded.

ui-timers.reason: Unrelated companion UI scheduling plus safety: page/tab/HomeBloc timers read and overwrite the manager shared command buffer during active motion. Their underlying read queries are implemented explicitly; no timer is allowed to replace a pending motor frame or delayed STOP.

index_order: Zero-based source order; nested inventories flatten controls/phases or variants/phase_inventory or variants/phases in source order. Ranges are inclusive. Every index belongs to exactly one rule. Explicit IDs remain for command/model/variant/source-control/source-phase and extra safety entries.
